title: Start: study system, how computers work, CS50P Lecture 0 (first half)
detail: Day 1: M00.U06 — set up learning-log.md + mistakes.md, install Anki, write AI-use policy (5 rules).
Day 2: M00.U01 — Crash Course CS #7 CPU + #8 Instructions & Programs; start how-my-computer-works.md.
Day 3: M00.U01 — Crash Course CS #18 Operating Systems + #19 Memory & Storage; Task Manager/htop exercise; 7B×2 bytes calc.
Day 4: M01.U01 — sign in to cs50.dev with GitHub; CS50P Lecture 0 from 0:00 to ~30:00 (print, input, variables, comments); `indoor` → check50 green.
Day 5: M01.U01 — Lecture 0 ~30:00–1:00:00 (f-strings, strip/title, split); `playback`, `faces` → check50 green.
Day 6: M00.U07 — Khan Algebra basics: negative numbers + fractions (1h).
Day 7 (review): 15 Anki cards from the week; quiz M00.U01 + M00.U06.

title: CS50P Lecture 0 (finish) + workstation setup + paths
detail: Day 1: M01.U01 — Lecture 0 1:00:00–1:28:33 (int, float, round, {x:.2f}); `einstein`.
Day 2: M01.U01 — Lecture 0 1:28:33–end (def, return); `tip`; check50 green on all 5 of Problem Set 0.
Day 3: M00.U02 — Software Carpentry shell ep. 02; working-directory experiment (paths.md).
Day 4: M00.U05 — Microsoft 'Install WSL', VS Code 'Developing in WSL', install Git + create GitHub account.
Day 5: M00.U05 — uv install + `uv python install 3.12`; rohitg00 01-dev-environment steps 1, 2, 7; run verify.py --route beginner until exit 0.
Day 6: M01.U01 — redo `tip` locally in WSL from a blank file; install check50 locally (`uv tool install check50`; fall back to cs50.dev if it fails).
Day 7 (review): quiz M01.U01 + M00.U02 + M00.U05 (≥80%); Anki.

title: Shell + Git basics + data representation
detail: Day 1: M02.U01 — Software Carpentry shell ep. 01–03; Bandit levels 0→3.
Day 2: M02.U01 — Bandit 4→5; create ~/code/cs50p and copy your Problem Set 0 in.
Day 3: M02.U05 — Software Carpentry Git episodes through 'Exploring History'; `git init` cs50p.
Day 4: M02.U05 — 'Ignoring Things'; Python .gitignore; one commit per problem; README.
Day 5: M00.U03 — CS50x Lecture 0 notes §binary/ASCII/Unicode; Crash Course #4; data-rep.md exercise.
Day 6: M00.U07 — Khan: percentages + linear equations (2h).
Day 7 (review): quiz M02.U01, M02.U05, M00.U03.

title: CS50P Lecture 1 — Conditionals + problem solving
detail: Day 1: M01.U02 — Lecture 1 0:00–~34:00 (if, elif/else, or, and); `deep`, `bank` in WSL.
Day 2: M01.U02 — Lecture 1 34:57–end (modulo, parity function, Pythonic bools, match at 48:17); `extensions`.
Day 3: M01.U02 — `interpreter`, `meal`; Truth Value Testing docs (truthiness gap); check50 green on all 5.
Day 4: M00.U04 — CS50x L0 notes §Algorithms/§Pseudocode; Think Python ch. 1; pseudocode + trace table.
Day 5: M00.U04 — Python Tutor traceback exercise (trace.md).
Day 6: M00.U07 — Khan: graphing lines (1h); commit & push all Problem Set 1 work.
Day 7 (review): quiz M01.U02 + M00.U04; Anki.

title: CS50P Lecture 2 — Loops, lists, dicts + shell pipes
detail: Day 1: M01.U03 — Lecture 2 0:00–~16:40 (while, for, range, while True/break/continue); `camel`.
Day 2: M01.U03 — Lecture 2 16:40–45:53 (lists, len); `coke`, `twttr`.
Day 3: M01.U03 — Lecture 2 45:53–end (dicts, Mario nested loops); `plates`.
Day 4: M01.U03 — `nutrition`; Think Python ch. 11 tuples + ch. 9 §slices (gaps); check50 green on all 5.
Day 5: M02.U02 — Software Carpentry shell ep. 04 Pipes and Filters + ep. 07 Finding Things.
Day 6: M02.U02 — log-forensics pipelines; curl + jq on the GitHub API; Bandit 6→12.
Day 7 (review): quiz M01.U03 + M02.U02; Anki.

title: CS50P Lecture 3 — Exceptions + Git branching
detail: Day 1: M01.U04 — Lecture 3 (whole, 44:33) + Python Tutorial §8.4/§8.6/§8.7 (raise, custom exceptions, finally); Corey try/except video.
Day 2: M01.U04 — `fuel`, `taqueria`.
Day 3: M01.U04 — `grocery`, `outdated`; InvalidFractionError + finally; check50 green on all 4.
Day 4: M02.U06 — Learn Git Branching 'Introduction Sequence'; Software Carpentry 'Conflicts'.
Day 5: M02.U06 — 'Ramping Up'; conflict + undo drill (undo.md); from now on one branch per problem.
Day 6: M00.U07 — Khan: exponents + scientific notation (1h).
Day 7 (review): quiz M01.U04 + M02.U06; rebuild `fuel` from blank in 30 min without notes.

title: Python memory model + GitHub flow
detail: Day 1: M01.U05 — Ned Batchelder 'Facts and Myths about Python names and values' (25 min) + text version.
Day 2: M01.U05 — Think Python ch. 9 §Objects and values/§Aliasing/§List arguments, ch. 10 §Lists and dictionaries (in Python Tutor).
Day 3: M01.U05 — Think Python ch. 16 §Equivalence and identity/§Deep copy, ch. 14 §Pure functions; copy module; Corey LEGB video.
Day 4: M01.U05 — six predict-the-output snippets (memory-model.md).
Day 5: M02.U07 — Software Carpentry 'Remotes in GitHub'; GitHub SSH docs; push cs50p over SSH.
Day 6: M02.U07 — GitHub flow + About pull requests; first issue → branch → PR → merge; external docs-typo PR.
Day 7 (review): quiz M01.U05 + M02.U07.

title: CS50P Lecture 4 — Libraries/APIs with venv, uv and secrets
detail: Day 1: M02.U08 — Python Tutorial ch. 12 (venv); Corey venv video; which-python before/after; rohitg00 lesson 06 + quiz.json.
Day 2: M01.U06 — Lecture 4 0:00–46:18 (random, statistics, sys.argv 21:21, slice); `uv init`; `emojize`, `figlet` with `uv add`.
Day 3: M01.U06 — Lecture 4 46:18–end (packages, requests/JSON 54:10, own libraries + __name__ 1:15:09); `adieu`, `game`.
Day 4: M02.U10 — 12-factor Config; rohitg00 04 Step 1; create CoinCap account + key in git-ignored .env; .env.example.
Day 5: M01.U06 — `professor`, `bitcoin` (CoinCap v3 key from env); check50 green on all 6.
Day 6: M01.U06 — CS50P L9 notes §argparse + Python argparse tutorial (gap); leaked-key runbook.
Day 7 (review): quiz M02.U08, M01.U06, M02.U10; confirm `git log -p` has no key.

title: CS50P Lecture 5 — Unit tests + shell scripting
detail: Day 1: M01.U07 — Lecture 5 (whole, 50:52) + pytest 'Get Started'.
Day 2: M01.U07 — `test_twttr`, `test_bank`.
Day 3: M01.U07 — `test_plates`, `test_fuel`; check50 green on all 4; parametrize one test (preview).
Day 4: M02.U03 — Software Carpentry ep. 05 Loops + ep. 06 Shell Scripts; backup.sh with set -euo pipefail + shellcheck.
Day 5: M02.U03 — Missing Semester 2026 'Command-line Environment' (signals, env vars, tmux); background/kill drill; Bandit 13→16.
Day 6: M00.U07 — Khan: functions + logarithm intro (2h).
Day 7 (review): quiz M01.U07 + M02.U03; Bandit 17→20 if time.

title: CS50P Lecture 6 — File I/O (+ pathlib/JSON/Unicode) + uv packaging
detail: Day 1: M01.U08 — Lecture 6 0:00–~30:00 (open, with, sorting lines); `lines`.
Day 2: M01.U08 — Lecture 6 ~30:00–1:23:50 (CSV, csv.reader, DictReader/DictWriter); `pizza`, `scourgify`.
Day 3: M01.U08 — Lecture 6 1:23:50–end (PIL); `shirt`; check50 green on all 4.
Day 4: M01.U08 — Corey Pathlib + Corey JSON videos; Unicode HOWTO 'Reading and Writing Unicode Data'; scan.py JSONL walker.
Day 5: M02.U09 — uv 'Working on projects', 'Managing dependencies', 'Locking and syncing'; convert cs50p to a uv project.
Day 6: M02.U09 — PyPA 'Packaging Python Projects'; build g2m-utils (src layout, entry point); publish to TestPyPI; `uvx` it.
Day 7 (review): quiz M01.U08 + M02.U09.

title: CS50P Lecture 7 — Regex + editor/AI hygiene + start OOP
detail: Day 1: M01.U09 — Lecture 7 0:00–~1:12:00 (re.search, patterns, groups at 52:46); `numb3rs`, `watch`.
Day 2: M01.U09 — Lecture 7 1:12:38–end (fullmatch, walrus, re.sub); `working`, `um`, `response`; check50 green on all 5.
Day 3: M02.U11 — VS Code Python tutorial (interpreter, debug, format-on-save); Missing Semester 2026 'Agentic Coding'.
Day 4: M02.U11 — AI-agent-on-a-branch PR review exercise; rohitg00 lesson 05 Jupyter.
Day 5: M00.U07 — Khan unit tests to 'Proficient' (2h).
Day 6: M01.U10 — Lecture 8 0:00–54:54 (tuples/dicts as data, classes from 28:14).
Day 7 (review): quiz M01.U09 + M02.U11.

title: CS50P Lecture 8 — OOP (+ dataclasses/enums/Protocols) + M00 capstone
detail: Day 1: M01.U10 — Lecture 8 54:54–1:48:32 (raise, __str__, @property at ~1:19:46); `seasons`.
Day 2: M01.U10 — Lecture 8 1:48:32–end (class methods, inheritance 2:18:11, __add__ 2:39:59); `jar`.
Day 3: M01.U10 — `shirtificate`; check50 green on all 3; ArjanCodes dataclasses video + Corey dunder methods.
Day 4: M01.U10 — ArjanCodes Protocol vs ABC + Enum HOWTO; start Task/Priority/Storage model (continues into week 13).
Day 5: M00.U07 — finish Khan unit tests; Σ and log₂ exercise (math.md).
Day 6: M00 capstone 'My machine, explained' — assemble the foundations repo; self-score with the rubric.
Day 7 (review): cumulative 20-MCQ quiz across M00 + M01.U01–U09 + M02.U01–U11 (≥80%); plan weeks 13–16.
